limitations: Complete report object is preserved; external raw media, runtime/dependencies, encoder telemetry, evidence spools and original stderr attachments are not embedded and cannot be reconstructed from this wrapper alone.

Matching decoded s16le streaming hash/byte-count receipts are original-run evidence; raw PCM bytes were not retained. Independent re-decode or independent raw PCM equality is not established by the wrapper.
Three serial encoder targets retained the same 168-byte x265 diagnostic: CPU-mask error-level line plus WPP and lookahead pool warnings; zero exits do not mean clean stderr.

Output stage paths refer to retained private calibration stages, not user publications. Original report does not assert a full output-file hash; any later full output-file hashes require separately dated provenance.
Time and storage ceilings are preregistered acceptance/point checks, not optimized throughput, a hard disk quota or guaranteed termination deadline.
Current 1080 range and Full-copy consumer bindings remain stale/refusing; no 1440 consumer, service, native, Windows, GPU or default promotion follows from calibration.

Independent saved audit reproduces selected frame/audio spool continuity and encoder-input TSV correspondence, not video pixels or raw PCM. Heldout selected video is0.433333–8.633333s and output0.020–8.220s versus audio0–8.208s: finite frame-grid selection, not arbitrary exact-picture cuts.
